thread:
Arjun: Quick question — thinking about adding a 'quant tolerance anchor' for FP8/INT8/4bit rollouts. Idea: require synthetic acceptability anchors (small evals) plus production shadow diffs before switching live. Thoughts?
Maria: Love the idea. Two concerns: (1) what metric(s) are anchors? perf vs quality? (2) how often to refresh for model drift?
Kevin: Metric = weighted utility (latency + quality penalty). For customer-visible SLOs we should use a delta on task success + LM perplexity proxies. Refresh weekly or on model change.
Olga: On refresh — need stratified sampling by endpoint (chat vs completions vs embeddings). Also record per-customer baselines to detect regressions that are masked by aggregate.
Devon: Runtime impact? We can't add per-request heavy validation. Keep shadow sampling async and a small % of traffic. Could tag requests with header x-quant-intent for debug.
Arjun: No runtime API change planned; just an ops header for sampling. We could re-use existing x-rw-shadow header.
Kevin: Also propose an 'anchor score' in telemetry: (A) baseline score, (B) current score, (C) delta. Alert when delta > 1.5 sigma for 24h.
Olga: Need p-value gating on anchor diffs. Small shifts during load spikes are noisy. Gate alerts behind significance plus sample size floor.
Maria: Ops playbook: block rollout if anchor delta > threshold OR if per-customer delta exceeds X. Allow canary rollback if automatic fallback sees >2x error rate.
Devon: Implementation sketch: 1) small synthetic bench harness (1000 prompts) run nightly. 2) shadow sampler 0.5% of live traffic. 3) per-customer aggregates stored in TSDB. 4) canary policy tied to anchor metric.
Arjun: Perf question: FP8 vs INT8 vs 4-bit — should we use separate anchors per precision lane? I think yes; each quant has different bias patterns.
Kevin: Agree. Plus cross-lane consistency checks: if FP8 improves latency but worsens a specific intent > threshold, that's a red flag.
Olga: Don't forget calibration drift for long-context — anchors must include long-turn dialogues when relevant.
Maria: Ops UI: surface anchor delta, sample counts, recent synthetic results, and quick rollback button. Also severity tags (:warning:).
sre-bot: Alert created: quant-anchor-delta for model redwood-v3q at 2026-03-21T12:34Z — sample size 2.1k, delta 1.8 sigma. /cc @Arjun
Arjun: Thanks — I'll triage. Next step: write short RFC for anchor schema + alert thresholds. Assigning to @Maria and @Devon to draft.
Maria: On it. I'll drop a PR with telemetry schema and sample queries.
Kevin: I'll add the math for the anchor score and a unit test harness.
Devon: I'll wire the shadow header and minimal sampling in the runtime. Quick question: do we want per-region anchors? Some customers saw region-specific quant noise.
Olga: Yes per-region and per-customer when feasible. Keep defaults global for small customers.
Arjun: OK let's sync tomorrow 10am. Thanks all :thumbsup:
